# WeMaAd

> WeMaAd is a senior product engineering studio based in Cairo, Egypt. We embed Rails and Next.js engineers directly into your team, or build end-to-end products for you.

## About

WeMaAd is a product engineering studio that specializes in embedding senior engineers into client teams or building complete software products end-to-end. We work with startups and businesses that need high-quality, production-ready engineering delivered fast.

- **Specializations**: Ruby on Rails, Next.js, React, AI integration, SaaS development
- **Location**: Cairo, Egypt
- **Model**: Staff augmentation (embedded engineers) or full product builds
- **Contact**: hello@wemaad.net | +20 114 254 9787

## Services

- **Embedded Engineering**: Senior Rails and Next.js engineers placed directly inside your team, working your hours, in your tools, with your codebase
- **End-to-End Product Builds**: Full product development from architecture and design through to deployment
- **AI Integration**: Incorporating AI capabilities into existing Rails and Next.js products
- **SaaS Development**: Building scalable multi-tenant SaaS platforms
